sectionDesc: Keys that connect your own systems to the company data
intro: An API key lets one of your systems — a management system, a turnstile, a reporting tool — read and write the company data without anyone signing in by hand. A key is valid for this company only, and acts with exactly the permissions you give it.

created.title: Key created
created.warning: This is the only time the key is shown — it cannot be retrieved later. Copy it now and store it where it is needed. If you lose it, revoke it and create another.

field.name: Name
field.nameHint: What this key is for. It appears in the activity log beside every operation the key performs.
field.scopesHint: Grant only what is needed. "Write" automatically includes read.
field.rateLimitHint: Ceiling for this key. 120 is plenty for normal use; raise it for a nightly job.

revoke.title: Revoke "{{name}}"?
revoke.message: The system using this key stops working immediately. Revoking cannot be undone: to restore the integration you will have to create a new key.

empty.title: No keys yet
empty.hint: Create the first key when you need to connect one of your systems to sonoQui.

atLimit: You have reached the maximum of {{max}} active keys. Revoke one you no longer use to create another.

docs.label: Download the technical documentation
docs.hint: The OpenAPI file with every endpoint and the permission each one needs, to hand to whoever builds the integration.

err.generic: That did not work. Please try again.
err.limit: You have reached the maximum number of active keys.
err.readOnly: Read-only session: keys cannot be created or revoked.
